forecaster_note: Nothing too exciting looking today. Head-to-slightly-overhead surf at the south exposures but onshore and lumpy under the southerlies. Small clean wave in the sheltered corners from leftover NE wind wave — best in the morning, probably fun enough on a small wave or longboard. — Hugh McDowell / Anthony Spinks, Surfline

wind.summary: Firm S 37 kph, gusting 65 — cross-shore at Dee Why/Manly, onshore at Long Reef/Curl Curl. Freshening through the morning.

days.label: Today
days.note: A powerful dead-S groundswell (7.5ft/8s, ~644kJ) is running but wraps badly and a firm onshore/cross S wind (37 gusting 65kph) keeps it lumpy almost everywhere. A smaller leftover NE windswell (3.9ft/8s) is the more playable option in sheltered corners, especially early. Long Reef and Curl Curl cop the worst of the onshore mess despite the size; Dee Why and Manly are more cross-shore and the better bets this morning.

dee-why.window: Best early while it's still just cross-shore — the dead-S angle wraps badly here so most of the push is junky; the NE leftover in the corners is cleaner.

tip.label: S swell wraps badly here
tip.text: Today's main energy is dead-S (~190°) — exactly the angle that doesn't work at the Point. Don't force the frontside rights; the backside lefts pick up more of what's usable, or just play in the smaller NE leftover.

long-reef.window: Ironically the one day size doesn't save it — direct onshore S wind on the S-facing reef makes this the worst-rated spot of the four despite the biggest swell.
alerts: Onshore wind directly hitting the reef — skip unless it backs off

tip.label: Skip today
tip.text: The reef usually loves S swell but a direct onshore S wind ruins it — not worth the drive unless the wind eases.

curl-curl.window: Biggest waves of the four but onshore and lumpy — early is the only shot before the wind fully takes hold.

tip.label: Size over quality
tip.text: Take the beachie peaks if you want the most push today — just expect it messy, not clean.

manly.window: Smallest of the four but most sheltered from the S energy and wind — cam confirms thigh-to-waist and clean-ish early.

tip.label: Sheltered fallback
tip.text: Least affected by today's dead-S swell direction — softer and smaller, but the cleanest cross-shore option going around.
